photosynthesis.label: Photosynthesis

concepts.label: Light energy
concepts.hint: Photosynthesis is powered by light energy from the Sun.

concepts.label: Chlorophyll / chloroplasts
concepts.hint: Chlorophyll (in chloroplasts) is the green pigment that captures light.

concepts.label: Carbon dioxide intake
concepts.hint: Plants take in carbon dioxide from the air.

concepts.label: Glucose produced
concepts.hint: Glucose (sugar) is the food the plant makes.

misconceptions.label: Plants don't eat soil
misconceptions.correction: Plants make their own food via photosynthesis; roots absorb water and minerals, not food.

photosynthesis.modelAnswer: Photosynthesis is how green plants use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to make glucose (food) and release oxygen. Chlorophyll in chloroplasts captures light energy to drive the reaction.
